An angel of a weapon with a devil's attitude. A piece of art that should never waste away in a display case.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Very Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 6 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with capacity modifying attachments. Using Autofire with this weapon expends 3 rounds instead of 10. This weapon can be reloaded without an Action by sacrificing the user’s Move Action as long as have at least one other open hand.

When this weapon inflicts a random Critical Injury (e.g., not a Leg Aimed Shot), the victim also suffers the effect of EMP Ammunition. When rolling for damage with this weapon, any damage die which land on a 1 are re-rolled until they result in a higher value. Provides a +2 bonus to Wardrobe and Style Checks if worn openly.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
